examples.title: A live run keeps its actions in reach
examples.description: The bar docks to the bottom of the page, flush, with a top border. On a short page it sits at the bottom edge rather than under the text (its parent is a flex column as tall as the page); on a long one the page scrolls behind it. It clears the home indicator and rides above the on-screen keyboard, and on touch every control is 44px.

examples.title: A decision bar with equal actions
examples.description: equalActions gives Deny and Approve the same width. The bar is a flush strip with a top border, docked to the bottom of the screen; below 32rem of bar width the pair takes its own row under the consequence line and shares it.

examples.title: Off together, with the reason
examples.description: While the stream is reconnecting the bar is off. Buttons that opt in with mutating stay focusable and are described by the reason, which is drawn under the row and announced politely. The field is read-only and muted, and at phone width the actions wrap instead of overflowing.
